name: National Fittings Limited
about: National Fittings Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of SG iron grooved and screwed pipe fittings, stainless pipe fittings, and ball valves for industrial and non-industrial applications in India. The company offers grooved pipe and screwed pipe, including ductile iron, and stainless steel; valves, includes ball, butterfly and check ductile valves; and pumps, including centrifugal, mini monoblock, open well, booster, submersible, dewatering, sewage dry vacuum, and vacuum pumps. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Interfit Techno Products Limited and changed its name to National Fittings Limited in September 2013. National Fittings Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Vadodara, India.
